scenes.heading: Nano Banana 2.1
scenes.say: It's Nano Banana 2.1. Not just text-to-image. It takes an image and transforms it. You give it a photo, it gives you a new one. Same subject, different scene, style, or action.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: Drop in a photo. Type what you want. Nano Banana 2.1 transforms it. In one demo, it dropped a person into a barrel wave. The detail, the lighting, the motion — it's a new level.

scenes.heading: 70,100 VIEWS THIS WEEK
scenes.say: Seventy thousand views this week. Two channels covering the same tool means artists and designers have noticed. The AI image space is getting competitive.

scenes.heading: TRY IT FREE
scenes.say: Nano Banana 2.1 has a free tier. Start generating immediately. No payment required. If you like it, upgrade for more features and higher resolution.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: Nano Banana 2.1 is impressive, but it's still AI image generation. Some outputs will look weird. And it's not free for heavy use. But for quick transforms and creative experiments, it's hard to beat.
